tool_caesar3.code:
def run(text):
    return ''.join(chr((ord(c) - 97 + 3) % 26 + 97) if 'a' <= c <= 'z' else c for c in text)

spec.description: Shift every lowercase letter of the input forward by 3 positions in the alphabet, wrapping z to c; keep other characters.

tool_digit_sum.code:
def run(text):
    return str(sum(int(c) for c in text if c.isdigit()))

spec.description: Return the sum of all digits that appear in the input string, as a number.
